tutorial_welcome: Welcome to GhostZap, the most secure chat you've ever used. Here the server reads nothing!
tutorial_e2ee_body: Your messages are locked on your device before leaving. Only the recipient has the key to open them.
tutorial_zero_body: The server doesn't store messages, keys or contact names. Nothing you do here leaves a trace on the server.
applock_sub: Protect your chat with a PIN and biometrics after a period of inactivity.
tutorial_ai_body: Use the magic wand while typing to correct or translate. Additionally, use the Microphone in the attachment menu to record audio that is automatically transcribed into text by our AI.
tutorial_lang_body: Choose PT, EN, ES, or ZH in the sidebar. The selected language changes the interface and defines which language the magic wand will translate your messages into.
legal_privacy_body:
1. GhostZap Commitment

GhostZap is a zero-knowledge system. This means we don't have access to your private keys or your message content.

2. Data Collection

We only collect your username and public key to allow other users to send encrypted messages to you.

3. End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)

All communications are encrypted on your device before being sent to the server.

4. Message Deletion

Messages on the server are temporary and act only as a relay. Once delivered, they can be removed by the system.

5. Incognito Mode (Expert Tip)

For maximum security against forensic analysis, we recommend using Incognito Tab. In this mode, data doesn't permanently touch physical storage (SSD/HDD).
legal_terms_body:
1. Responsible Use

By using GhostZap, you agree not to use the platform for illegal activities or those that violate third-party rights.

2. Disclaimer

GhostZap is a private communication tool. We are not responsible for the content exchanged between users.

3. Account Security

You are solely responsible for maintaining the security of your device. If you lose access to your browser/IndexedDB without backup keys, messages will not be recoverable.
legal_help_body:
👻 Vanishing Messages

Use the clock icon to set the TTL (Time-To-Live). Ephemeral messages disappear forever from both devices after the time is up.

🪄 Artificial Intelligence

Use the magic wand to fix grammar or translate automatically. Use the Microphone to transcribe audio messages into text instantly.

🔑 Fingerprint

If the fingerprint code is the same for you and your friend, the connection is secure.

tutorial_ttl_body: In the clock icon, you define how long the message lasts. After the time, it disappears forever.
tutorial_master_reset_body: In the security settings (gear icon), you can enable Auto-wipe. If you don't use the app for 6h, 12h, or 24h, it deletes all local history and keys for security.
tutorial_recovery_body: If the app is reset or you change your phone, use your 12-word phrase (generated in settings) to restore your identity and resume chatting.
tutorial_temp_photo_body: Send photos that the recipient can only see once.
tutorial_pwa_body: If you chose not to install on first access and want to install now:
tutorial_pwa_android: On Android/Chrome: Click the 3 dots (⋮) and then Install App.
tutorial_pwa_ios: On iPhone/Safari: Click the Share (↑) button and then Add to Home Screen.
tutorial_pwa_pc: On PC: Click the installation (🖥️+) icon at the end of the address bar.
tutorial_browser_body: Your data is saved only in this browser (IndexedDB). If you clear the browser cache, the messages disappear.
